duration.text: The Marxist Philosophy at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. photocopy of awards certificate If applicable 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Master's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
